title: Copilot setup pre-commit cache misses when setup-python downloads a different micro version
answers: copilot agent setup is slow even though caches hit
pre-commit reinstalls hook environments despite cache restore
copilot session setup takes 40-50 seconds before work starts
setup-python interpreter mismatch with cached pre-commit env
body:
Symptom: Copilot agent sessions spend roughly 40-50s in setup before work starts, and pre-commit reinstalls hook environments even though the cache restored.
Root cause: .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml setup-python step without pin-micro-version: false downloads a separate Python interpreter, while the cached pre-commit environments were built under the runner's preinstalled interpreter, so keys hit but environments are rebuilt.
Fix pattern: pass pin-micro-version: false to ./.github/actions/setup-python in the setup steps, matching lint.yml, so setup uses the same interpreter the caches were built with and skips the interpreter download.
Constraints: the pin only matters where the cached environments were built under the preinstalled interpreter; the PR measured this in the Copilot setup file only and does not show whether other workflows have the same mismatch.
applies: The setup-python step in the Copilot setup steps workflow; check lint.yml before changing it there.
says: Agent sessions spend forty to fifty seconds in setup before work can start.
Automated coding sessions reinstall checking environments even when cache restores report a hit.
The coding assistant downloads a different language runtime version instead of using preinstalled tools.
Why does the assistant workspace rebuild hook environments despite finding a cached copy?
Reduce startup delay by preventing the coding agent from reinstalling already cached tools.
search: In .github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml, the setup-python step must set pin-micro-version: false to match .github/workflows/lint.yml and use the runner's preinstalled Python interpreter. Omitting this input downloads a separate Python interpreter that mismatches the cached pre-commit environments, forcing hooks to reinstall and delaying agent sessions by 40 to 50 seconds despite cache hits. This constraint applies to setup-python in the Copilot setup steps workflow where environments were built under the preinstalled interpreter.
